ambiguity_information_bound.READ_explanation: A truthful acquired raw WRITE changes the observation and can identify the missing key/value; it is additional information, so the pre-READ bound no longer applies.
ambiguity_information_bound.randomized_policy_scope: Private randomness must be independent of hidden completion conditional on all admitted observations.

constructive_policy.description: Accept exactly when all positive-probability hidden completions consistent with the visible typed prefix give the same target. Otherwise abstain. Equivalent to exact posterior point mass / CERTAIN group; no hash sampling.
constructive_policy.inputs: Declared task-law plus observed x/dt/observed only; no labels, target_available, hidden erased payload, IDs, seeds, prior truth feedback or future information.

finite_sample_limits.branch_counts: nA initial-erased-overwritten; nB initial-erased-still-needed; nC final-update-erased

general_visible_only_MAP_acceptance_fami.parameter_a: Population fraction of final-ambiguous state-query observations accepted; independent of hidden completion conditional on the observation. All certain accepted; initial-unknown rejected.

independent_symbolic_check.method: Fix injective value assignment originals0..3/fresh4..5; exhaust all12 ordered update-key pairs and6 erased WRITE identities. For each visible prefix enumerate all3 initial-erasure or9 final-erasure completions; point mass depends only on these visible completions. Evaluate final-WRITE availability separately as verification-only bookkeeping. A bijection of eight value classes lifts the counts to every injective assignment.

law: Four distinct original values uniformly sampled from eight; two distinct uniformly selected ordered Selective update keys assigned two distinct fresh values; one of six WRITE events erased uniformly and independently; each of four keys queried once. Independent nuisance clocks/query order/typed distractors disclose no hidden completion.

read_fee_upper_bound.derivation: (sum_j [1-max_y P(Y_j=y|visible prefix)])/4. Revealing earlier/more than an actual causal READ is a relaxation; already-emitted answers cannot increase the bound.
read_fee_upper_bound.law_specific_baseline: Bayes MAP of the exact admitted observation law, no abstention, fixed four equally weighted queries, pure mean correctness minus one actual READ fee; truthful READ resolves the sole erased WRITE. Not an arbitrary frozen neural baseline.

scope_limits: Exact stated finite sampling law, not a distribution over actual NumPy PRNG seeds or arbitrary raw observation sources
Available/known coverage uses evaluation-only final-WRITE-observed mask only in theorem scoring, never policy input
Pooled population ratio is not per-episode mean, finite-batch confidence bound, or per-branch coverage guarantee
No new neural mechanism, analytic-core increment, implementation/adoption or empirical gate pass
No multiple erasures, shifted/unknown laws, resampling, open-domain, GPU, energy or production qualification
